scope: Inserted classical REF-DUST-FB-01 only. Physical CST correspondence, boundary, trapping and regularity remain separately HOLD; no future completion or event-horizon determination.

reference.domain: 0<=x<=1, round symmetry spheres only; R=0 excluded as degenerate sphere; exterior R>=Rb(x) with explicit membership test
reference.slicing: Ingoing marginally-bound Painleve-Gullstrand T, dust proper time inside, exterior E=1 free-fall time; no periodic cell
reference.metric: ds^2=-dT^2+(dR+v*dT)^2+R^2*dOmega^2; v=-H R inside, sqrt(2GM/R) outside
reference.boundary: Comoving zero-pressure material surface; test h and K from both sides, density step without thin shell

area_calibration.method: Symmetric derivative of squared areal radius along exact interior radial null rays, in declared T normalization; reject paths crossing surface or center; compare using outward intervals

decision.zero_overlap: HOLD_SIGN_UNRESOLVED; interval containing zero is not evidence of an exactly marginal surface
decision.marginal: Separate analytic equality/root existence with bounded location and negative other expansion
decision.normalization: positive reciprocal boosts preserve signs/product; magnitude tolerance requires fixed normalization
decision.physical_CST: HOLD_NOT_ELIGIBLE_NOT_RUN; unknown uncertainty or missing surface/null reconstruction prevents qualification

hypothetical_tolerance_box.scope: Worst-case sign diagnostic only, not actual physical confidence intervals; no independence assumed and other error contributions absent

regularity.event_records: All crossings in the fixed window for the predefined mass/shell grid, at each planned density ratio, plus every fixed mass/time/density checkpoint

controls: marginal not inferred from zero-containing interval
junction density jump not thin shell
